o.text: From Arabic ذَات (ḏāt). Doublet of zad.
From yad (“foreign, alien”) + planet + -li. Possibly a calque of Russian иноплане́тный (inoplanétnyj).
From Persian میخانه (mey-xâne), equivalent to mey + -xana.
